name: Sourced claim: big centred line
when: The hook or a chapter-level statement: a big claim in two centred lines, then its source. It stands on the shot blurred and dimmed (`ground`).
anchor: The scene starts on the claim's first word; the source box (`source_at`) lands once the claim has been said, or on the outlet's name.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.line1: the claim's first line, as the voice says it
vars.line2: the claim's second line; empty = a one-line claim
vars.source: the words before the outlet: Confirmed by, Reported by, Previewed by
vars.outlet: the outlet's name. Shown as text when there is no logo, else the logo's alt text
vars.logo: the outlet's logo file: build_video.mjs fills it from the repo's assets/logos/ when the outlet is listed in logos.json (or give a file the user supplied); empty = the sentence ends on the outlet's name as text
vars.logo_h: the logo's height in px (this box is 96 tall): about 39 for a wordmark (Edge 39.4), 32 for a very long one, 46 for IGN, 63 for a square mark (Rockstar)
vars.logo_trim: px taken off the box's right padding after the logo: 16 for a square mark such as Rockstar's, else 0
vars.source_at: seconds after the start: when the source box lands
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The claim (two lines), the source words and the outlet are values, and so is the box's landing time; the logo is a file from the project (empty = the outlet's name as text), and the lab's per-outlet logo sizes are the values logo_h and logo_trim. The blurred, dimmed shot is the `ground` (the validated clip's exact filter), baked by the project.
